carShare.terms_lead: Three of these come up later: the fuel line, new scratches, and extensions. Read those before you confirm.
carShare.terms_p1: 1 — Return time. Being late costs ¥220 for every 10 minutes, counted from when you tap “Return” in the app, not from when you park.
carShare.terms_p2: 2 — Fuel. Return the car above half a tank. The fuel card is on the dashboard; use it and keep the receipt in the holder.
carShare.terms_p3: 3 — Scratches. Photograph anything you find before you drive off. Sent after you start driving, it counts as damage from your rental.
carShare.terms_p4: 4 — Parking bay. Put the car back in the bay you took it from. If someone is in it, call support instead of picking another bay.
carShare.terms_p5: 5 — Key. The key goes back in the holder inside the car. Take it home and every booking after yours stops.
carShare.terms_p6: 6 — Smoking and pets. Neither is allowed; cleaning is ¥22,000. A small dog in a carrier is fine if you tell us beforehand.
carShare.terms_p7: 7 — Tolls. The ETC card is already in the reader. If you use your own card instead, send a photo of the receipt.
carShare.terms_p8: 8 — Accidents. If anyone else is involved, call both the police and support. Do not settle anything at the roadside.
carShare.terms_p9: 9 — Extensions. You can extend in the app up to your return time. After it passes, extending is closed and the late fee applies.
carShare.terms_p10: 10 — Things left behind. Drop them in the station post box. Left in the car, they get mixed up with the next person's.
carShare.terms_p11: 11 — Washing. A dusty car is fine to return; you do not need to wash it. Wipe up anything you spilled inside.
carShare.terms_p12: 12 — Cancelling. Free until 24 hours before the booking. After that, the table below.
